name: DRD Install Core
description: Use webforms to install a new core on a host
project_description: Submodule of Drupal Remote Dashboard (DRD). Lets you provision a brand-new Drupal site from a Webform submission and register it with the dashboard in one step. A Webform handler ('DRD Core Installer') creates the drd_core and drd_domain entities, seeds their authentication (shared secret) and OpenSSL encryption settings, and prepares the domain-secrets payload the target site's DRD Agent needs; a companion Webform element ('DRD Domain') collects the site URL, and a GitLab API event subscriber records the newly created repository against the core. Requires the DRD base module, Webform and GitLab API.
